1. What is the Metropolis TruHealth Active Male package?
The Metropolis TruHealth Active Male is a preventive health checkup designed for Indian men aged 25 to 55, especially those with a family history of illness or a lifestyle-linked risk profile. It covers 70+ parameters in a single blood and urine sample, including male-specific markers like total testosterone and Prostate-Specific Antigen (PSA), along with full panels for heart, liver, kidney, thyroid, diabetes, complete blood count, vitamins and cancer-screening markers. The package is processed at Metropolis Healthcares NABL-accredited laboratory and is bookable online through bookmytest.co.in.
2. What tests are included in the Metropolis TruHealth Active Male package?
The TruHealth Active Male package by Metropolis includes Complete Blood Count (CBC), Lipid Profile, Liver Function Test (LFT), Kidney Function Test (KFT), Thyroid Profile (T3, T4, TSH), HbA1c and Fasting Blood Sugar, Vitamin D 25-Hydroxy, Vitamin B12, Iron Studies, Total Testosterone, Prostate-Specific Antigen (PSA), HsCRP for cardiac inflammation, and a complete Urine Routine examination. The exact parameter list, normal ranges and a sample Metropolis report are visible on the package page on bookmytest.co.in before booking.
3. Why is testosterone testing important for Indian men?
Testosterone influences energy, muscle mass, fat distribution, libido, mood, sleep quality and bone density. Low testosterone in Indian men is increasingly being diagnosed even in the 30s, driven by obesity, sleep deprivation, chronic stress and metabolic syndrome. Symptoms include persistent fatigue, reduced gym performance, abdominal weight gain, loss of morning erections and irritability. The Metropolis TruHealth Active Male package includes a morning total testosterone test that confirms whether levels are below the normal adult male range of roughly 300 to 1,000 ng/dL.
4. What does the PSA test in this package detect?
PSA, or Prostate-Specific Antigen, is a protein produced by the prostate gland. Elevated levels can indicate benign prostate enlargement, prostatitis or, in some cases, prostate cancer. The normal range is generally below 4 ng/mL, though it varies with age. PSA screening through the Metropolis TruHealth Active Male package is particularly important for men above 45, men above 40 with a family history of prostate cancer, and those experiencing urinary symptoms such as frequent night-time urination, weak stream or incomplete bladder emptying.
5. Is fasting required for the Metropolis TruHealth Active Male test?
Yes, a 10 to 12 hour overnight fast is required. Fasting is essential for accurate lipid profile, fasting glucose, insulin and testosterone readings, all of which are affected by recent food intake or time of day. Plain water is allowed and recommended during the fasting window. Continue your prescription medication unless your doctor advises otherwise, and avoid alcohol for 24 hours and intense gym workouts for 12 hours before the Metropolis phlebotomist arrives for sample collection.
6. At what age should Indian men start taking the Metropolis full body checkup?
Indian men should begin annual preventive health checkups from age 25, especially with a desk job, irregular sleep, family history of diabetes, heart disease or thyroid disorder, or a BMI above 25. From age 40, PSA and cardiac risk markers become particularly important. The Metropolis TruHealth Active Male package is built around exactly this profile, combining metabolic, hormonal and male-specific screening in a single sample. Annual repeat testing helps build a personal baseline so any drift in HbA1c, LDL or testosterone is caught early.
7. Is Metropolis a trusted lab for full body checkups in India?
Yes. Metropolis Healthcare is one of Indias largest and most respected diagnostic chains, with NABL-accredited laboratories, decades of clinical reputation and a panel of senior pathologists. The TruHealth series of preventive packages is curated by Metropolis specialists and is widely used by corporate health programmes, insurance partners and individual customers across India. Booking the Metropolis TruHealth Active Male through bookmytest.co.in gives you the same lab quality with transparent partner pricing and free home sample collection.
8. How long does it take to receive the Metropolis TruHealth Active Male report?
Reports are delivered within 24 to hours of sample pickup. Samples collected in the early morning slot typically reach the Metropolis processing laboratory the same day, and digital reports are emailed and sent on WhatsApp by the next evening. A few specialised parameters like Vitamin B12 or hormonal markers may need an additional 12 hours. You can also download the report anytime from your bookmytest.co.in dashboard or directly from the Metropolis TruHealth portal using your registered mobile number.
9. Is home sample collection available across India for this Metropolis package?
Yes, free home sample collection by trained Metropolis phlebotomists is available across 2,000+ pincodes covering all major metro cities, tier-2 cities and most tier-3 towns in India. After booking on bookmytest.co.in, the phlebotomist arrives at your address in a 2-hour slot of your choosing, ideally between 6 AM and 10 AM for fasting samples. There are no hidden charges for the visit, report generation or digital delivery anywhere in India.
10. What should I do if my Metropolis TruHealth report shows borderline values?
Borderline values are early warnings rather than disease diagnoses, and most of them are reversible through lifestyle changes. A fasting glucose of 105 mg/dL, an HbA1c of 5.8%, an LDL of 110 mg/dL or a testosterone of 290 ng/dL are all borderline and respond well to weight reduction, strength training, improved sleep, reduced alcohol and targeted supplementation. Consult a physician, repeat the Metropolis test in three months, and track the trend rather than reacting to a single value.

Hypothyroidism is significantly more common in Indian women than men, with prevalence rising sharply after the age of 30 and around pregnancy or menopause. It can silently cause fatigue, weight gain, hair fall, irregular periods, infertility, low mood and dry skin — symptoms often mistaken for everyday stress. A simple TSH, T3 and T4 blood test confirms the diagnosis. Untreated hypothyroidism affects cholesterol, fertility and heart health, which is why annual thyroid screening is strongly advised for adult women.
4. Why is iron deficiency screening important for women?
Iron-deficiency anaemia is one of the most under-diagnosed conditions in Indian women, affecting more than half of women of reproductive age. Heavy menstrual flow, pregnancy, breastfeeding and vegetarian diets all increase the risk. Symptoms include persistent tiredness, breathlessness on stairs, hair fall, brittle nails, pale skin and poor concentration. The Active Female package tests haemoglobin, ferritin, iron and TIBC together, which gives a far more accurate picture than haemoglobin alone.

For the most accurate results, ideally schedule the test for the week after your period ends. The Metropolis TruHealth Expert Female package includes an allergy screening panel that helps identify whether unexplained symptoms — chronic skin rash, recurrent sinus issues, persistent cough, food sensitivities, joint pain or gut discomfort — could be allergy-driven rather than infection-driven. This is increasingly relevant for Indian women aged 35+, where allergic and autoimmune presentations rise sharply. Specific allergen testing can then be ordered as a follow-up based on which broad category is flagged.
4. How does this package help women going through perimenopause and menopause?
Perimenopause typically begins between 38 and 45 in Indian women and brings symptoms like irregular periods, sleep disruption, mood changes, weight gain, hair fall, fatigue and palpitations — often confused with thyroid disorder or stress. The Expert Female package screens thyroid, key hormones, iron, Vitamin D, calcium and cardiac risk markers together, which is the exact combination needed to differentiate perimenopausal changes from other treatable conditions. Annual testing through this phase is strongly advised.

Annually for most women aged 35+, and every six months for women with a confirmed family history of cancer, autoimmune disease, diabetes or thyroid disorder, or those on long-term medication for hypertension, PCOS or hormonal therapy. Persistent fatigue despite normal basic reports, recurrent infections, unexplained weight changes, irregular cycles after age 35, family history of cancer or autoimmune disease, post-pregnancy symptoms that have not resolved, suspected hormonal imbalance, or any "everything is normal but I dont feel well" situation. Metropolis TruHealth Vital Plus is a foundational annual health checkup designed for working Indian adults who want a reliable vital-organ screening without going into premium-tier depth. It evaluates 60+ parameters in a single blood and urine sample, focusing on the systems most affected by modern lifestyle — heart, liver, kidney, thyroid, blood sugar, complete blood count and Vitamin D. The package is processed at Metropolis Healthcares NABL-accredited laboratory and bookable online through bookmytest.co.in.
2. Is TruHealth Vital Plus a unisex package or only for one gender?
The Metropolis TruHealth Vital Plus is a unisex package suitable for both Indian men and women aged 25 to 45. It focuses on lifestyle-related vital-organ screening that applies equally across genders, which makes it especially practical for couples, working spouses or family members who want to book together at the same time and slot. For gender-specific concerns like testosterone, PSA in men or detailed hormonal and iron screening in women, the Active Male or Active Female packages are more appropriate.
3. How is Vital Plus different from the basic TruHealth Vital package?
The TruHealth Vital package covers core organ-function basics, while the Vital Plus tier adds additional parameters — typically Vitamin D, expanded thyroid coverage, complete urine examination and a deeper lipid breakdown — taking the total to roughly 60+ parameters. The "Plus" upgrade is meaningful for Indian adults because Vitamin D deficiency, fatty liver and subclinical hypothyroidism are extremely common but invisible on a basic panel. For most first-time annual testers, Vital Plus is the better starting point.
4. Is the Vital Plus package suitable for someone taking their first annual blood test?
Yes, the Metropolis TruHealth Vital Plus is one of the most beginner-friendly annual checkups available in India. It covers the most clinically relevant parameters at this life stage, the report is colour-coded for easy interpretation, and a complimentary doctor consultation is included with most bookings on bookmytest.co.in to help you understand any flagged values. It is widely chosen by people in their late 20s and early 30s taking their first preventive blood test after starting full-time work.
5. Can a working couple book TruHealth Vital Plus together with home sample collection?
Yes, couples and family members can book multiple Metropolis TruHealth Vital Plus packages in a single home-visit slot, which is one of the most common booking patterns on bookmytest.co.in. The Metropolis phlebotomist collects all samples in one visit, typically scheduled between 6 AM and 10 AM for the fasting requirement, and individual digital reports are delivered separately to each registered mobile number within 24 to 48 hours. This saves time and is a popular option for couples doing annual wellness together.
6. Why is Metropolis TruHealth Vital Plus called a "vital organs" checkup?
The package is built around the bodys vital organ systems — the heart (via lipid profile and HsCRP), liver (via SGPT, SGOT, bilirubin), kidney (via creatinine, urea, eGFR), thyroid (via TSH, T3, T4), pancreas (via fasting glucose and HbA1c), and blood-forming system (via complete blood count). It also assesses Vitamin D status, which influences bone, immunity and energy. Together these define the "vital" baseline of how well the bodys most critical systems are functioning, which is why this package is widely used for annual screening.
7. How does Vital Plus compare with a typical hospital pre-employment or insurance checkup?
A hospital-conducted pre-employment or basic insurance checkup usually covers 30 to 40 parameters and is priced significantly higher because of consultation, facility and overhead costs. The Metropolis TruHealth Vital Plus delivers 60+ parameters with a comparable or wider clinical scope, processed at a NABL-accredited central lab, with the convenience of home collection and digital reporting. For Indian working professionals who already have insurance but want a deeper personal annual baseline, Vital Plus is a more clinically useful and cost-efficient option.
8. Can the Vital Plus package detect early fatty liver, pre-diabetes or thyroid issues?
Yes. The liver function panel in Vital Plus can flag elevated SGPT and SGOT levels that often indicate early non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD), which is now extremely common in Indian adults with sedentary lifestyles. The HbA1c and fasting glucose readings together identify pre-diabetes well before overt diabetes develops. The thyroid panel detects subclinical hypothyroidism — a very common silent condition in Indian adults. Catching any of these at the early stage often means lifestyle correction alone can reverse the trend.

Vital Plus does not include male-specific markers like testosterone or PSA, female-specific hormonal panels, advanced cancer-screening markers, allergy testing or detailed iron studies. If you are above 35, have a strong family history of cancer, diabetes, heart disease or thyroid disorder, are planning pregnancy, are in perimenopause, or have unexplained chronic symptoms, you should upgrade to the gender-specific Active, ProActive or Expert tier. Vital Plus is intentionally focused — it is the essential adult baseline, not the deepest screening.

Reports are delivered within 24 hours of sample pickup, emailed and sent on WhatsApp, and downloadable anytime from the bookmytest.co.in dashboard or Metropolis TruHealth portal using your registered mobile number. 1. What is the Metropolis TruHealth ProActive Female package?
The Metropolis TruHealth ProActive Female is an advanced preventive health checkup designed for Indian women aged 30 and above, especially those with a family history of illness or a higher lifestyle risk profile. It evaluates 80+ parameters in a single blood and urine sample, covering heart, liver, kidney, thyroid, diabetes, anaemia, bone health, hormonal balance, key vitamins and cancer-screening markers. The package is processed at Metropolis Healthcares NABL-accredited laboratory and bookable online with free home collection through bookmytest.co.in.
2. What tests are included in Metropolis TruHealth ProActive Female?
The TruHealth ProActive Female package by Metropolis includes Complete Blood Count (CBC), Lipid Profile, Liver Function Test (LFT), Kidney Function Test (KFT), Thyroid Profile (T3, T4, TSH), HbA1c and Fasting Blood Sugar, Vitamin D 25-Hydroxy, Vitamin B12, Iron Studies, Calcium, HsCRP for cardiac inflammation, hormonal markers and a complete Urine Routine examination. The exact 80+ parameter list, normal ranges and sample Metropolis report are visible on the package page on bookmytest.co.in before booking.
3. How is ProActive Female different from the regular Active Female package?
The ProActive Female package is the upgraded, more comprehensive version of the Active Female checkup. While the Active Female covers around 70 parameters focused on core metabolic and nutritional health, the ProActive Female adds extra cancer-screening markers, expanded hormonal panels, deeper cardiac risk assessment and additional bone-health indicators — taking the total to 80+ parameters. It is recommended for women above 30, women with a family history of cancer, diabetes or thyroid disease, and those wanting a deeper annual screening.
4. Why is this Metropolis package recommended for Indian women?
Indian women face a unique combination of high hypothyroidism prevalence, widespread iron-deficiency anaemia, very high Vitamin D deficiency, early-onset metabolic syndrome and rising rates of breast and cervical cancer. The Metropolis TruHealth ProActive Female package is curated by Metropolis pathologists to screen exactly these high-prevalence conditions in a single sample. It is particularly valuable for women with a family history of cancer, diabetes, thyroid disorder or heart disease, and for women approaching perimenopause.
5. Is fasting required for the Metropolis TruHealth ProActive Female test?
Yes, a 10 to 12 hour overnight fast is required. Fasting is essential for accurate lipid profile, fasting glucose and insulin readings, which are directly affected by recent food intake. Plain water is allowed and recommended during the fasting window. Continue your prescription medication unless your doctor specifies otherwise. Avoid alcohol for 24 hours and heavy exercise for 12 hours before the Metropolis phlebotomist arrives, as both can temporarily alter liver enzymes and other key readings.
6. Can I take the Metropolis ProActive Female test during my period?
You can, but a few parameters may be affected. Haemoglobin and ferritin readings can be marginally lower during menstruation, and inflammatory markers like HsCRP may be slightly elevated. For the most accurate results, schedule the Metropolis TruHealth ProActive Female test for the week after your period ends. If your cycle is irregular or your booking is time-sensitive, proceeding is still fine — just inform the phlebotomist so the report can be interpreted accurately by your physician.
7. At what age should Indian women take the ProActive Female checkup?
The Metropolis TruHealth ProActive Female package is ideal for Indian women from age 30 onwards, especially with a family history of illness, sedentary work, irregular cycles, BMI above 25 or post-pregnancy. From age 40, with menopause approaching, the expanded hormonal and bone-health panels become particularly valuable. Annual repeat testing helps build a personal baseline so subtle drift in TSH, ferritin, HbA1c or Vitamin D is caught early and treated before it progresses to clinical disease.
8. How long does it take to get the Metropolis TruHealth ProActive Female report?
Reports are delivered within 24 hours of sample pickup. Samples collected in the early morning slot typically reach the Metropolis processing laboratory the same day, with digital reports emailed and sent on WhatsApp by the next evening. A few specialised parameters like Vitamin B12 or certain hormonal markers may need an additional 12 hours. You can also download the report anytime from your bookmytest.co.in dashboard or the Metropolis TruHealth portal using your registered mobile number.
9. Is Metropolis a trusted lab for preventive checkups in India?
Yes. Metropolis Healthcare is among Indias most respected diagnostic chains, operating NABL-accredited and ISO-certified laboratories, with a senior panel of pathologists and decades of clinical reputation. The TruHealth series is designed in-house by Metropolis specialists and is widely used in corporate wellness, insurance health checks and individual preventive care across India. Booking the Metropolis TruHealth ProActive Female through bookmytest.co.in gives you the same lab quality with transparent partner pricing and zero hidden home-collection charges.
10. Is home sample collection available across India for this package?
Yes, free home sample collection by trained Metropolis phlebotomists is available across 2,000+ pincodes covering all major metro cities, tier-2 cities and most tier-3 towns in India. After booking on bookmytest.co.in, a female phlebotomist (on request) arrives at your address in a 2-hour slot of your choosing, ideally between 6 AM and 10 AM for fasting samples. There are no extra charges for the visit, report generation or digital delivery — pricing remains transparent across the country.
